## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and any companion `atom-crm-web` change.

## Verification

List actual commands and results, including relevant test execution/skip counts. If verification was blocked, state the reason. For frontend/API changes, identify the pair of revisions tested together.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff and excluded secrets, private records, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] I followed the applicable architecture, authorization, tenant, transaction, and migration contracts.
- [ ] I added appropriate regression coverage or explained why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated affected API/configuration documentation and coordinated frontend contracts where needed.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check` and recorded the checks relevant to this change.

Do not use this public template to disclose exploitable vulnerabilities; follow `SECURITY.md`.
